comment: Per-device facts droidtop cannot ask Android for: the pad's USB identity, how many panels the device really has, and quirks worth naming. Every field here is read off the device; nothing is inferred from a spec sheet. Fields droidtop's controller detection reads (docs/SPEC.md 7b): match.model (ro.product.model, case-insensitive; match.manufacturer optional), gamepad.name/vendorId/productId (the built-in pad's identity), gamepad.glyphFamily (xbox, playstation or nintendo: what is PRINTED on the face buttons, which no toggle changes), layoutToggle {property, values{<value>: {keysSwapped, confirmOn: bottom|right, keycodes{bottom, right, top, left: the Android key code each button reports, BUTTON_A/B/X/Y}}}} for a system setting that changes the layout at any time (keycodes, when present, is what droidtop reads; keysSwapped says the same for older readers: true when the right button reports BUTTON_A), and displays[] {role: internal|addon, width, height, position: top|bottom}: every built-in panel (a device may have several) and the device's own add-on display, with the panel's native mode and where it physically sits; droidtop names the matching screens "Top screen" / "Bottom screen", matching a built-in panel by its size in either orientation and an add-on by its exact size (an add-on without a size only when it is the one external screen connected). A value not listed is unknown, never guessed.
